findings.claim: Decoded terminal learning labels are unavailable (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false), so descendant credit is recorded joint-head survival credit, not final affinity benefit. Lineage support shows 349 nodes with fewer than 3 ancestors and 531 with fewer than 6, and terminal metadata records one future resampling node per batch at terminal_index 99 (score_time 0.99, state_time 1.0). Survival enrichment effects (e.g., survival_effects:0 landmark_00_soft_mass z=0.365, q=0.120; survival_effects:96 landmark_09_local_czz z=-0.390, q=0.120; survival_effects:249 landmark_04_local_cyz change-rate z=1.791, q=0.302) are therefore survivor-biased joint-head credit and cannot be presented as final affinity benefit; the immediate-selection versus descendant-credit comparison is unavailable.

Immediate endpoint selection evidence disagrees with descendant survival credit in direction for several features. Endpoint effects are positive for pair_kernel_1.5 (z=0.562, q=1.5e-4), pair_kernel_2.5 (z=0.631, q=2.2e-5), pair_kernel_3.5 (z=0.540, q=9.8e-5), pair_kernel_5.0 (z=0.319, q=0.0037), landmark_00_occupancy3 (z=0.545, q=2.4e-4), landmark_00_occupancy5 (z=0.208, q=0.020), landmark_06_softmin (z=0.294, q=6.8e-4), landmark_18_softmin (z=0.264, q=0.0060), while negative for pair_kernel_7.0 (z=-0.485, q=1.5e-4), landmark_00_softmin (z=-0.481, q=8.1e-4), landmark_06_occupancy5 (z=-0.365, q=6.8e-4), landmark_18_occupancy5 (z=-0.311, q=0.0038). Survival enrichment for the same features is weak and mostly non-significant (e.g., survival_effects:0 landmark_00_soft_mass q=0.120; survival_effects:96 landmark_09_local_czz q=0.120), so direction priorities should weight the immediate endpoint evidence over the survivor-biased descendant credit.

Multiplicity-adjusted branch evidence ranks coordinate hypotheses differently from point estimates alone. After BH adjustment, pair_kernel_1.5 (branch_adjusted:86 adjusted_covariance q=0.081; branch_adjusted:240 adjusted_correlation q=0.019) and pair_kernel_2.5 (branch_adjusted:87 q=0.077; branch_adjusted:241 q=0.046) retain support, while joint_innovation_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:151 q=0.020; branch_adjusted:228 q=9.3e-5; branch_adjusted:305 q=2.8e-4) and joint_internal_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:153 q=0.030; branch_adjusted:230 q=1.5e-4; branch_adjusted:307 q=9.7e-4) are the strongest adjusted signals. A concrete priority decision that differs from ranking point estimates alone: prioritize joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A (negative adjusted correlations, q<0.001) above landmark_02_softmin (branch_adjusted:97 raw_covariance q=0.290) and landmark_18_softmin (branch_adjusted:145 q=0.059), whose point estimates are larger in magnitude but do not survive adjustment.

Independent-batch agreement and opposing observations constrain coordinate rules. pair_kernel_1.5 and pair_kernel_2.5 show same_sign_batch_fraction 0.929 (13/14 batches) with positive adjusted correlations (branch_adjusted:240, branch_adjusted:241), and joint_innovation_RMS_A and joint_internal_RMS_A show same_sign_batch_fraction 0.929-1.0 with negative adjusted correlations (branch_adjusted:228, branch_adjusted:230, branch_adjusted:305, branch_adjusted:307). The counterexample that would weaken a proposed pair-kernel direction is shape_yy (branch_adjusted:158 raw_correlation q=2.6e-3; branch_adjusted:235 adjusted_correlation q=0.015), which is negative with same_sign_batch_fraction 1.0 and would oppose a uniform positive pair-kernel rule; reproducibility and this counterevidence should limit use of any single-sign coordinate rule.

Local coordinate information is separable from global pose and shape using supplied joint diagnostics. selection_innovation/innovation_native_alignment (joint_diagnostics:1, mean 0.092, p=1.5e-9) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (joint_diagnostics:11, mean 0.226, p=1.2e-9) are positive, while observed_child_score_gain is negative (joint_diagnostics:2, mean -0.036, p=1.8e-7). teacher_contrast_internal_fraction (joint_diagnostics:14, mean 0.787) exceeds translation (joint_diagnostics:12, mean 0.132) and rotation (joint_diagnostics:13, mean 0.081) fractions, and joint_internal_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:153, q=0.030) is significant while joint_translation_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:152, q=0.072) is weaker. This supports treating internal-coordinate regions as adding information beyond common motion; the surrounding coordinates that should retain freedom are the global centroid and rigid-pose components, which the supplied tool did not adjust (raw_covariance global_centroid_x/y/z q=0.72-0.97).

Coherent joint coordinate patterns are distinguishable from isolated marginal descriptors. The pair-kernel family (1.5, 2.5 A) is coherent across raw and adjusted covariance/correlation with same-sign batch fractions 0.79-0.93 (branch_adjusted:86, branch_adjusted:87, branch_adjusted:240, branch_adjusted:241), and the joint RMS family is coherent with negative adjusted correlations (branch_adjusted:228, branch_adjusted:230, branch_adjusted:305, branch_adjusted:307). Isolated marginals such as shape_yy (branch_adjusted:158, branch_adjusted:235) and joint_innovation_RMS_A (branch_adjusted:151) carry coupling or redundant evidence that should not be averaged with incompatible conformations into an unsupported target; the supplied covariance and intact-conformation diagnostics identify this coupling rather than a single averaged descriptor.

The supplied continuous contrast functions span observed support [0.0, 0.49] with no extrapolation allowed (extrapolation_allowed=false for all 200 rows). Sign changes are frequent (e.g., continuous:0 landmark_00_soft_mass sign_changes=4, strong_sign_conflicts=1; continuous:1 landmark_00_local_dx sign_changes=6, strong_sign_conflicts=9; continuous:17 landmark_01_local_cxy sign_changes=7, strong_sign_conflicts=18), and fit fidelity is poor for many features (relative_node_RMSE up to 0.997 for continuous:77 landmark_07_local_cxy). Curve support audit (curve_support) selected 24 curves under relative_rmse_le 0.35 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0, with quiet_node_large_fit_fraction up to 0.34 for pair_kernel_5.0. A constant rule is not supported over a time-conditioned rule for features with multiple sign changes and strong conflicts; validated observed-node interpolation is the only permitted expression, and a contrast curve is not an absolute reward target.

Population-contrast changes and parent-child increment contrasts differ, and the turnover residual is an accounting diagnostic. For landmark_00_soft_mass, population_rate z=0.185 (turnover:0), edge_rate z=4.545 (turnover:1), turnover_residual_rate z=-4.360 (turnover:2). For landmark_00_local_cxx, population_rate z=-0.058 (turnover:12), edge_rate z=-4.343 (turnover:13), turnover_residual_rate z=4.286 (turnover:14). For landmark_00_local_cyy, population_rate z=0.258 (turnover:15), edge_rate z=-4.793 (turnover:16), turnover_residual_rate z=5.051 (turnover:17). Similar large residual rates appear for landmark_01_local_cyy (turnover:47 z=6.397), landmark_04_local_cxx (turnover:134 z=5.671), landmark_07_local_cxx (turnover:224 z=5.076), landmark_07_local_cyy (turnover:227 z=5.633), landmark_08_local_cxx (turnover:254 z=5.543), landmark_08_local_cyy (turnover:257 z=4.579), landmark_16_local_cyy (turnover:497 z=6.367), landmark_17_local_cxx (turnover:524 z=5.244), landmark_19_local_cxx (turnover:584 z=5.298), landmark_19_local_cyy (turnover:587 z=5.368). The residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling, so it is not a causal selection effect or atom velocity; the evidence supports changing cohort composition and reclassification rather than a clean within-path change.

Parent-child increment contrasts are mostly non-significant after multiplicity adjustment. increment_effects:14 landmark_00_softmin (q=0.046, negative_batch_fraction 0.929) and increment_effects:15 landmark_00_occupancy3 (q=0.081, positive_batch_fraction 0.857) are the strongest, while increment_effects:3 shape_xx (q=0.095), increment_effects:4 shape_yy (q=0.161), increment_effects:7 shape_xz (q=0.207), increment_effects:10 pair_kernel_2.5 (q=0.208), increment_effects:13 pair_kernel_7.0 (q=0.208), increment_effects:25 landmark_03_occupancy5 (q=0.161), increment_effects:34 landmark_06_occupancy5 (q=0.256), increment_effects:63 landmark_16_occupancy3 (q=0.222), and increment_effects:70 landmark_18_occupancy5 (q=0.382) do not survive. This limits within-path change claims and supports treating the increment contrasts as descriptive rather than causal selection effects.

The information audit reports compressed_choice_excess_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.081 (CI95 0.070-0.092), compressed_choice_fixed_RMS_A mean 0.564 (CI95 0.499-0.620), compressed_choice_proper_rigid_RMS_A mean 0.529 (CI95 0.468-0.582), top4_teacher_overlap mean 0.470 (CI95 0.427-0.515), compressed_chosen_teacher_score_correlation mean 0.102 (CI95 0.065-0.140), and full_chosen_teacher_score_correlation mean 0.064 (CI95 0.021-0.103). The audit states these are not the full score-weighted reward or its FLOWR Jacobian, nonnegative excess distance is by construction, proper rigid alignment retains fixed Hungarian correspondence, and teacher score correlations are observational and not a fitted or independently validated affinity predictor. Joint diagnostics (joint_diagnostics:0-10) are descriptive within-selector associations with batch as the independent unit; only innovation_native_alignment (joint_diagnostics:1) and observed_child_score_gain (joint_diagnostics:2) and teacher_innovation_contrast_alignment (joint_diagnostics:11) are null-tested.

Teacher modes are static: source configs/experiments/steer_dependency_v1/static.json.gz, count 28, assignment_rms_A_quantiles [0.446, 0.863, 1.050], temperature_edits=false. The incumbent program D2_without_trajectory_static uses coordinate_representation predicted_endpoint_world_A, derivative_path flowr_endpoint_vjp, reward_view endpoint_pointcloud, teacher_neighbors 4, pointcloud_delta_A 1.0, mixture_temperature 0.5, teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0, teacher_score_beta 0, time_ramp_power 0.0, and window [0.0, 0.5]. Fixed parameters mixture_temperature 0.5 and teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2 4.0 are immutable. The formula registry states the executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, and legacy robust_delta is ignored. Allowed edits are pointcloud_delta_A [0.5, 1.0, 2.0], region_index evidence-bound landmark, teacher_neighbors [2, 4, 8], temporal_region_index evidence-bound landmark and verified continuous salience, and temporal_teacher_blend [0.25, 0.5, 1.0]; no temperature edit is permitted.

Regional enrichment effects and their change rates are diagnostic and not absolute reward targets. Strong enrichment_z values include regional_effects:0 landmark_00_soft_mass z=0.639 (q=1.9e-4), regional_effects:22 landmark_02_local_dy z=0.405 (q=1.3e-4), regional_effects:62 landmark_06_local_dy z=0.425 (q=1.1e-4), regional_effects:75 landmark_07_local_cyy z=-0.646 (q=7.1e-5), regional_effects:92 landmark_09_local_dy z=0.325 (q=4.8e-4), regional_effects:100 landmark_10_soft_mass z=0.395 (q=3.7e-4), regional_effects:142 landmark_14_local_dy z=0.350 (q=2.0e-4), regional_effects:165 landmark_16_local_cyy z=-0.672 (q=1.3e-4), regional_effects:175 landmark_17_local_cyy z=-0.560 (q=1.1e-4), regional_effects:182 landmark_18_local_dy z=0.425 (q=4.3e-4), regional_effects:195 landmark_19_local_cyy z=-0.622 (q=4.7e-4). Change-rate effects (regional_effects:200-399) and parent-edge contrast rates (regional_effects:400-599) are mostly non-significant after adjustment, so they should not be averaged into an unsupported target.

hypotheses.claim: Hypothesis: a temporal_teacher_blend recipe with temporal_region_index bound to landmark_00 and verified continuous salience will increase endpoint landmark_00_soft_mass enrichment relative to the static incumbent, observable as a positive change in regional_effects:0 enrichment_z at the endpoint.

Hypothesis: a region_index bound to the pair_kernel_1.5/2.5 coherent region with pointcloud_delta_A 0.5 will preserve the positive adjusted pair-kernel correlation (branch_adjusted:240, branch_adjusted:241) while reducing joint_innovation_RMS_A, observable as a negative change in branch_adjusted:228 adjusted_correlation.

Hypothesis: a region_index bound to the joint internal-motion region with teacher_neighbors 8 will reduce joint_internal_RMS_A, observable as a more negative branch_adjusted:230 adjusted_correlation, without changing the immutable mixture_temperature or teacher_endpoint_temperature_A2.

Hypothesis: a time-conditioned rule using only validated observed-node interpolation (curve_support selected 24 curves with relative_rmse_le 0.35 and strong_sign_conflict_nodes_eq 0) will outperform a constant rule for features with multiple sign changes, observable as reduced relative_node_RMSE in the selected curves.

Hypothesis: the large turnover_residual_rate values (e.g., turnover:2 z=-4.360, turnover:14 z=4.286, turnover:17 z=5.051, turnover:47 z=6.397, turnover:134 z=5.671, turnover:224 z=5.076, turnover:227 z=5.633, turnover:254 z=5.543, turnover:257 z=4.579, turnover:497 z=6.367, turnover:524 z=5.244, turnover:584 z=5.298, turnover:587 z=5.368) reflect changing cohort composition and score reclassification rather than within-path change, and should not be used as a causal selection effect or atom velocity.

Hypothesis: parent-child increment contrasts are descriptive rather than causal because only increment_effects:14 (q=0.046) and increment_effects:15 (q=0.081) approach significance while the remaining tested increments (q=0.095-0.382) do not survive multiplicity adjustment.

limitations: Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity; decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false.
Turnover residual includes score reclassification and extant-parent weighting, not only resampling.
Adjusted branch covariance is supplied evidence; region moments themselves are not rigid-motion residuals.
Curve fitting does not establish causal benefit or a gradient; no time bins or outside-window analysis.
Static teachers are last-learning-node forecasts, not actual final structures.
All weak and null scalar effects retained; current study outcomes are withheld from design roles.
The executing pointcloud scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term; legacy robust_delta is ignored.
Temperatures are immutable task parameters; no temperature edit is permitted.
